# A Graph Method

## Abstract

We present a graph method that improves accuracy on benchmark X.

## Introduction

Graph methods are widely studied [@Smith2023Deep]. Earlier work extended them [@Kim2024Own].

## Related Work

Deep methods for benchmark X were studied before [@Smith2023Deep].

## Method

We build a graph over the inputs and propagate features along its edges.

## Experiments

Figure 1 shows that our method reaches 87.3 accuracy, while the baseline reaches 85.0.

![Main results](figures/fig_main.png)

*Figure 1: main results on X.*

## Conclusion

The method works well on benchmark X.

## Limitations

We evaluate on a single benchmark.

## References
